Description: Waking up tired even after 7-8 hours sleep for 2+ weeks
Self_Check_Question: Do I feel rested when I wake up?
Intervention: Reduce workload by 30% for 1 week. If no improvement → see doctor

Description: Postponing decisions or defaulting to 'I don't know'
Self_Check_Question: Am I avoiding making choices about the product?
Intervention: Use 5-minute decision rule for reversible decisions. Batch irreversible ones to Monday.

Description: Negative self-talk about the startup's chances of success
Self_Check_Question: Do I still believe this product matters?
Intervention: Return to customer interviews — hear real impact stories

Description: Avoiding team calls, canceling meetings, not responding to messages
Self_Check_Question: Am I avoiding people I used to enjoy talking to?
Intervention: Schedule 1 non-work social activity this week. Call a friend.

Description: Headaches, chest tightness, digestive issues, muscle tension without medical cause
Self_Check_Question: Am I experiencing new or worsening physical symptoms?
Intervention: See a doctor. These are stress-response signals.

Description: Finishing tasks but feeling no satisfaction
Self_Check_Question: When was the last time I celebrated a win?
Intervention: Start 'done' list. Write 3 daily accomplishments before bed.

Description: Unable to ship because nothing feels 'good enough'
Self_Check_Question: Have I delayed shipping something for >1 week due to polish?
Intervention: Set a ship date and honor it. 80% is enough.

Description: Scrolling Twitter/LinkedIn feeling inadequate about own progress
Self_Check_Question: Am I comparing my daily grind to others' highlights?
Intervention: Unfollow 5 accounts that trigger comparison. Follow 5 builders instead.

Description: Working 12+ hours but output declining — busy ≠ productive
Self_Check_Question: Am I getting less done despite working more?
Intervention: Track actual productive hours. Usually <4hrs of deep work is max.

Description: Skipping meals, no exercise, inconsistent sleep for >2 weeks
Self_Check_Question: Am I eating regularly, moving daily, and sleeping 7+ hours?

Description: Snapping at team or co-founder over small issues
Self_Check_Question: Am I overreacting to minor problems?
Intervention: Take 48-hour break. Then have honest conversation.

Description: Persistent feeling of being a fraud despite evidence of competence
Self_Check_Question: Do I feel like I'm faking it and will be discovered?
Intervention: List 5 things you've accomplished. Talk to mentor/peer.

Description: Consistent anxiety or dread about the week ahead
Self_Check_Question: Do I look forward to my work?
Intervention: Identify what specifically you dread. Can it be delegated/eliminated?

Description: Checking Slack/email during dinner, before bed, on weekends
Self_Check_Question: Can I go 4 hours without checking work?
Intervention: Set phone boundaries: no work apps after 8pm. Use screen time limits.

Description: Constant worry about runway, revenue, personal finances
Self_Check_Question: Am I losing sleep over money?
Intervention: Calculate exact runway. Make plan for scenarios. Separate business + personal finances.
